definition: יִתְרוֺן noun [masculine] advantage, profit , only Ecclesiastes; — absolute Eccl 1:3 + 4 t.; construct Eccl 2:13 + 4 t.; — advantage to ( ל ) any one, מַהיִֿתְרוֺן לָאָדָם Eccl 1:3 , i.e. what advantage hath a man ? Eccl 5:15 ; Eccl 10:11 followed by מִן comparative = advantage beyond, more than Eccl 2:13 (twice in verse); construct יִתְרוֺן הָעוֺשֶׂה Eccl 3:9 advantage of (for) him that worketh ; יִתְרוֺן אֶדֶץ Eccl 5:8 יִתְרוֺן דַּעַת Eccl 7:12 advantage of knowledge ; וְיִתְרוֺן הַכְשֵׁיר חָכְמָה Eccl 10:10 an advantage for giving success is wisdom ; absolute אֵין יִתְרוֺן תַּחַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ Eccl 2:11 .
